notes: Reachable and relevant, but I only saw search-result snippets. The listed URL is a March 2018 PDF, and WebFetch returned binary with no readable text. The 2024 and 2023 files are .docx, which WebFetch can't decompress, and Bash and PowerShell are disabled here, so I couldn't unzip them. All figures below come from search-snippet summaries, not from text I read in the documents. The Board posts these as 'Purchase Recommendations' or 'purchases and renewals', usually in Mar, May, Jul and Sep. The May 2024 item is a $25M, 5-year sole-source Illumina reagent contract at the Carver Biotechnology Center. The prior contract (Jul 2023 to Jun 2024) was about $5M with 5%, 10% and 12% discounts on most items (March 2018 snippet). No 2025 or 2026 Illumina items surfaced. Whether a $25M estimated ceiling for 5 years versus about $5M for the prior renewal term reflects volume, price or scope cannot be told without reading the files.
how_to_mine: Download these files and unzip the .docx (word/document.xml) locally, or open the PDFs. (1) https://www.trustees.uillinois.edu/trustees/agenda/May-16-2024/19a-May-24-Purchase-Recommendations.docx : find the Illumina item and record the term, estimated cost, prior contract value and any discount language. (2) https://www.trustees.uillinois.edu/trustees/agenda/March-30-2023/025-mar-23-purchases-and-renewals.docx : NovaSeq X Plus item. (3) https://www.trustees.uillinois.edu/trustees/agenda/March-15-2018/025-mar-Purchases-Renewal-Report.pdf : original 5-year Illumina contract, so the $/year trend can be compared with 2024. Then search for the same pattern in the Mar, May, Jul, Sep and Dec agendas for 2023 to 2026 (trustees.uillinois.edu/trustees/agenda/<Month-DD-YYYY>/), and also UIC and UIS sole-source Illumina items. Look for the phrases 'Illumina', 'DNA Analyzer', 'Carver', 'discount' and 'prior contract'. Also check whether the prior-term value is stated, so $/yr can be compared (about $1M/yr in the 2018 renewal term versus about $5M/yr ceiling in 2024).

items.label: 1B
items.claim: UIUC Carver Biotechnology Center sole-sourced a five-year Illumina reagent contract with a $25M estimated ceiling starting Jul 2024.
items.detail: The Board's May 16, 2024 purchase recommendations list Illumina reagents for the Carver Center's DNA Analyzer Systems. The term is 1 Jul 2024 to 30 Jun 2029 with one 5-year renewal option, and the estimated cost is $25,000,000. The justification is that the items are patented and required for research, and the center's six Illumina sequencers need Illumina reagents. This is a snippet-level read. The text on discounts or price terms was not seen, and the prior term (about $5M) points to a roughly 5x larger ceiling, which could be volume and the NovaSeq X rather than price.
items.source_name: University of Illinois Board of Trustees, Purchase Recommendations
items.why_new: A university sole-source Illumina contract with dollar ceiling and term is not in the known list of procurement sources.

items.label: 2A
items.claim: A prior UIUC Illumina sole-source renewal (term Jul 2023 to Jun 2024) carried tiered discounts of 5%, 10% and 12% on most items.
items.detail: The March 2018 Board purchase and renewal report lists a sole-source renewal of about $5,000,000 (estimated) from Illumina with a 5%, 10% and 12% discount on the majority of items. This is a snippet-level read, and it is old (2018) and unconfirmed. If the 2024 file lacks a comparable discount line, that would show a change in terms. Only the 2018 snippet shows tiered academic discount levels in the 5-12% range, which is shallow compared with the 'insane discounts' large accounts reportedly get.
items.source_name: University of Illinois Board of Trustees, Purchases and Renewal Report
items.why_new: No public-university contract-level discount percentages are in the known list.
